summary: Backend CNC multi-tool feature is fully working: 10/10 pytest cases pass (GET/PUT /api/tools, project export produces 4-layer DXF (FUGA/CONTORNO/TAGLIO/SVASO) with configured ACI colors, boat nested-dxf + export/{fmt}, legacy svg/pdf exports still OK, Element.tool persisted via PATCH and routed to correct layers). Frontend /tools screen works end-to-end (loads 4 tools, color palette, edit-save-persist, success toast). CRITICAL frontend bug: the editor TEXTURE panel throws a red-screen 'toolColor is not defined' whenever the piece has existing elements — makes the editor unusable for any real project. Bug is in TexturePanel which uses toolColor/classifyTool defined in parent Editor scope but not passed as props.

ui_bugs.issue: Red-screen runtime error 'toolColor is not defined' at app/editor/[id].tsx:1474:62 (and classifyTool at 1476) — used inside TexturePanel but declared as useCallback in parent Editor scope. Crashes as soon as the TEXTURE tab renders a piece with elements.length > 0. Reproducible on project 6a849a7dd824444bccd581e6. Fix: pass toolColor and classifyTool as props to TexturePanel (or move the helpers inside TexturePanel using toolCfg passed as prop).

action_items: Fix TexturePanel red-screen: pass toolColor and classifyTool (or toolCfg) as props to <TexturePanel /> in app/editor/[id].tsx around line 945, and reference the prop versions on lines 1474 & 1476. This unblocks the whole editor.
After fix, retest editor TEXTURE tab on a piece with elements to confirm no red screen and that the element list dot color matches the configured tool color.
critical_code_review_comments: TexturePanel (app/editor/[id].tsx:1372) is defined outside the Editor component and cannot see the parent's useCallback closures (toolColor at line 207, classifyTool at line 201). Any element rendered in the elements.map crashes the app.
backend/server.py is 1265 lines — consider splitting projects/boats/exports/photogram/vectorize into routers.
PUT /api/tools returns 422 only when the entire submitted list has no valid ids; single invalid entries are silently dropped (server.py:1029). Consider stricter validation.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (/tools screen + home gear icon OK; editor modals not reachable due to red-screen bug)

The editor red-screen ('toolColor is not defined') must be fixed before any UI flow that touches TEXTURE tab can be verified. Do NOT tap AGGIUNGI/RIEMPI on user projects (boat 6a849a5fd824444bccd581e5); create a throwaway boat/piece via POST /api/boats then /api/projects if a save flow is required.
rca_of_issue: Bug: Editor TEXTURE tab red screen. RCA: TexturePanel (app/editor/[id].tsx:1372) is a separate function component but references toolColor(el) and classifyTool(el) which are useCallback closures declared inside the Editor component (lines 201-215). JS closure scoping means those identifiers are undefined inside TexturePanel, so as soon as elements.map renders any row it throws 'toolColor is not defined'. Reproduction: open /editor/6a849a7dd824444bccd581e6 → tap TEXTURE tab. Mitigation: pass toolColor and classifyTool (or the raw toolCfg array with a locally-defined helper) as props to <TexturePanel /> in the render around line 945 and use the prop versions on lines 1474 & 1476.
